title: Evaluation of the Effects of KCNQ1 Mutation on Insulin Tolerance and Obsessive Compulsive Features in Long QT Romano-Ward Syndrome Patients.
brief_summary: The objectives of the study are to investigate if KCNQ1 mutation in Romano-Ward long QT patients can be associated with changes in insulin regulation and with psychological features of compulsivity, impulsivity and behavioural rigidity.
